final_message: {"title":"鼓脸晃头","poses":["0.00 s: Draw florist Nailü waist-up in her debut costume, twin tails, lime streak, heart cowlick and white hair flowers; face forward with both closed fists beside her collar.","0.55 s: Keep both fists visible beside the collar; inflate her cheeks halfway, purse her lips and shift her eyes toward her own left.","1.10 s: Fully puff her cheeks and tilt her head left; hold the leftward gaze as twin tails, flowers and cowlick trail toward her right.","1.65 s: Reach the deepest left tilt with puffed cheeks and steady fists; let twin tails and ornaments swing left after the head.","2.20 s: Rock her head through center toward her right; keep cheeks inflated, bring her eyes toward center and let hair and flowers trail left.","2.75 s: Reach the deepest right tilt with eyes forward and both fists still beside the collar; swing twin tails, flowers and cowlick toward her right.","3.30 s: Rebound toward center, part her lips and release a small breath puff; shrink her cheeks as hair and flowers trail right.","3.85 s: Settle nearly upright with normal cheeks and forward eyes; fade the breath puff and loosen both fists slightly below the collar.","4.40 s: Hold a tiny residual right tilt with relaxed cheeks and forward eyes; begin lifting and closing both hands as the hair settles toward the opening pose."],"continuity":"Use a fixed waist-up camera for one 4.8-second loop, preserve costume and ornament placement with both hands visible, and bridge the distinct ninth and first poses through a small head return and fist lift."}
